en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a quiet street lined with early 20th-century houses. The buildings feature wooden and stucco facades, steeply pitched roofs, and decorative elements typical of northern or eastern European small towns. The street is unpaved and appears rather empty, suggesting a rural or small-town setting. There is a sign on the building to the right, but it is mostly illegible due to the image quality.
